title: Choose alpha and bulk cutoff before the class-dependent finite head
statement: For a finite strongly connected SINGLE complex graph with fixed positive rates in arbitrary finite dimension, one sufficiently small fixed alpha>0 gives mu(x)=product_i(x_i!)^(-alpha) and L*mu<0 outside a class-dependent finite head WHERE every coordinate is at least graph/rate-dependent K. Choose alpha, boundary dissipation slack, K, then the class head. The exact mixed factorial identity, O(1/min x) errors and conservation/monomial escape supply this order; K is class-independent while the finite head need not be. Summability of mu and all its polynomial/exponential moments does not fill infinite bounded-coordinate strips.
